backlog.spec: Add a k-nearest-neighbour classifier on binary Morgan radius-2 2048-bit fingerprints using Tanimoto similarity (computed as intersection / union from a dense 0/1 matrix product). For each test molecule, take the k=10 most similar training molecules and predict the similarity-weighted fraction of positives (weights = similarity**3, fallback 0.5 if all weights are zero). Rank-normalise its output and add it as a third member, with weights 1/3 each, to the existing RF and MLP rank blend. Keep all other code unchanged.
backlog.title: Tanimoto kNN as rank-blend member

backlog.spec: Combine the two most promising single findings so far into one configuration. (a) In featurize, append a radius-2 Morgan count fingerprint folded to 1024 columns, transformed with log1p, to the existing RDKit descriptor block and Gobbi pharmacophore block (use rdkit.Chem.rdFingerprintGenerator.GetMorganGenerator(radius=2, fpSize=1024).GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy, cast to float, then np.log1p). (b) Replace the RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=1000, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed). Keep the 5-seed MLP on the quantile-normal transform of the same (now wider) matrix and keep the 0.5/0.5 rank-average blend unchanged. Watch runtime: 15 fits must finish well inside 10 minutes, so if needed keep the MLP at 5 seeds and max_iter=200 as now.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees plus log1p Morgan counts

backlog.spec: The MLPs currently early-stop on a random 10 percent of the training fold, which shares ring skeletons with the training rows and therefore gives an optimistic, scaffold-leaky stopping signal. Replace this with a scaffold-disjoint hold-out. Compute the Murcko scaffold SMILES of every training molecule (rdkit.Chem.Scaffolds.MurckoScaffold.MurckoScaffoldSmiles, falling back to the empty string on failure), then use sklearn.model_selection.GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.15, random_state=seed) grouped on scaffold to split the training fold into an inner-train and an inner-validation part. Train each of the 5 MLPs with early_stopping=False on the inner-train part while manually monitoring validation AUROC: simplest clean implementation is to use warm_start=True with max_iter=1 inside a loop of up to 150 epochs, tracking inner-validation AUROC each epoch, and keeping the predictions from the epoch with the best validation AUROC (predict on test at that epoch). Average over 5 seeds, then rank-blend 50/50 with the unchanged RF.
backlog.title: Scaffold-grouped validation split for MLP early stopping

backlog.spec: Compute the Tanimoto kernel matrix on binary Morgan radius-2 bits for train-train and test-train pairs, using the intersection/union formula from dense 0/1 products. Fit sklearn KernelRidge with kernel='precomputed', alpha=1.0, on targets encoded as +1 for positives and -1 for negatives. Use the raw predictions for test molecules, rank-normalise them, and add them as a third member with weight 1/3 in the rank blend. Keep the RF and MLP unchanged. This is a regression-on-kernel variant, distinct from the earlier SVC.
backlog.title: Kernel ridge regression on a Tanimoto kernel as a blend member

backlog.spec: Change the MLPs to learning_rate_init=3e-4, batch_size=64, n_iter_no_change=20, max_iter=400, early_stopping=True, validation_fraction=0.15. Keep the (256,64) layers and alpha 1e-2, with 5 seeds. Keep the blend unchanged.
backlog.title: Adam MLP with a longer schedule

backlog.spec: The MLP currently sees ~2048 sparse pharmacophore columns alongside ~210 dense descriptors, which likely drowns the descriptors. Change only the MLP's input: split the feature matrix into the descriptor block and the pharmacophore block, fit TruncatedSVD(n_components=128, random_state=seed) on the training pharmacophore block, and build the MLP input as the quantile-normal-transformed descriptors concatenated with the SVD scores (standardized by the training mean/sd of the scores). Fit the TruncatedSVD and QuantileTransformer on the training fold only and apply them to the test fold. The RF keeps the full uncompressed matrix, and the final 0.5/0.5 rank average is unchanged.
backlog.title: SVD-compressed pharmacophore block for the MLP

backlog.spec: Soften the MLP's targets so it is not pushed to saturate on a small, scaffold-shifted dataset. Replace the 5 MLPClassifier fits with 5 MLPRegressor fits (same hidden_layer_sizes=(256, 64), alpha=1e-2, early_stopping=True, max_iter=300, random_state=seed + i) trained on smoothed targets y_soft = 0.1 + 0.8 * y on the quantile-normal feature matrix. Average the 5 regression outputs; because only the ranking matters, use the raw averaged output directly as the MLP score. Rank-average it 0.5/0.5 with the unchanged RF probability exactly as the current script does.
backlog.title: Label-smoothed MLP trained as a regressor

backlog.spec: Confirm the single best observed result by re-running it exactly: in fit_predict, replace RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier(n_estimators=1000, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed) and keep everything else identical (same featurize with descriptors + Gobbi pharmacophore bits, same 5-seed MLP on the quantile-normal matrix, same 0.5/0.5 rank average). Import ExtraTreesClassifier from sklearn.ensemble and leave the N_TREES/MAX_FEATURES constants wired to the new model so the file stays tidy. The only purpose of this job is a clean replicate of the 0.0890 observation, so change nothing else, and keep runtime similar to the current script (ExtraTrees with 1000 trees on ~4000 features is fast, well under the limit).
backlog.title: Replicate ExtraTrees in place of the RF

backlog.spec: In the MLP member, change the solver from the default adam to lbfgs (MLPClassifier(solver='lbfgs', hidden_layer_sizes=(256,64), alpha=1e-2, max_iter=500)). Drop early_stopping and validation_fraction, which lbfgs does not use. Keep the 5-seed averaging and the quantile-normal inputs. Keep the RF and the rank blend unchanged. The aim is a deterministic full-batch optimiser that may fit small tabular data better than adam.
backlog.title: L-BFGS MLP instead of Adam

backlog.spec: For the MLP branch only, apply TruncatedSVD (n_components=128, random_state=seed) to the quantile-normal matrix, fit on the train fold. Standardize the result and train the 5 MLPs on it. The RF still uses raw features. Rank-blend as before.
backlog.title: SVD-compressed MLP input

backlog.spec: Instead of picking between the many models that all scored near 0.090-0.093, average them all, since averaging many decorrelated rankers usually beats any single pick. Keep featurize as is. Build four rank-normalized prediction vectors on the same feature matrix: (a) the current RandomForestClassifier(300 trees, max_features 0.3), (b) the current 5-seed MLP on the quantile-normal matrix, (c) LGBMClassifier(n_estimators=600, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=15, colsample_bytree=0.3, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, min_child_samples=10, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed, verbose=-1), and (d) CatBoostClassifier(iterations=600, depth=6, learning_rate=0.05, random_seed=seed, verbose=0, thread_count=8). Return the equally weighted mean of the four rankdata(p)/len(p) vectors. Watch the budget: the whole job must finish 15 fits inside 10 minutes, so if needed drop CatBoost iterations rather than adding threads.
backlog.title: Four-model rank average of the near-tied families

backlog.spec: Add the RDKit path-based (Daylight-style) topological fingerprint as an extra feature block, which is untried here and captures linear path substructures rather than the circular environments of Morgan or the pharmacophore patterns of Gobbi. In featurize, use rdkit.Chem.rdFingerprintGenerator.GetRDKitFPGenerator(minPath=1, maxPath=6, fpSize=1024) and call GetCountFingerprintAsNumPy on each molecule, cast to float64 and apply np.log1p, then hstack this 1024-column block after the existing descriptor and Gobbi blocks. Keep the RF settings, the 5-seed MLP on the quantile-normal transform, and the 0.5/0.5 rank blend exactly as they are.
backlog.title: Append RDKit topological path fingerprint counts

backlog.spec: Exploit the unlabeled test molecules, which are available inside fit_predict. First fit the current pipeline (RF + 5-seed MLP rank blend) as it stands and obtain blended scores for the test set. Then take the test molecules whose blended score falls in the top 15 percent (pseudo-label 1) or bottom 15 percent (pseudo-label 0), append their feature rows and pseudo-labels to the training matrix with sample weight 0.3 (the original rows get weight 1.0), and refit both the RF (which accepts sample_weight) and the MLPs (for the MLPs, approximate the weighting by simply including the pseudo-labeled rows once). Return the rank-averaged blend from this second round. Keep the two rounds strictly inside fit_predict and make sure total runtime for 15 folds stays under 10 minutes by leaving model sizes unchanged.
backlog.title: Transductive pseudo-label self-training round

backlog.spec: Add sklearn BernoulliNB (alpha=1.0) trained on binarised Morgan radius-2 bits plus the Gobbi pharmacophore bits (the existing 2048-bit pharmacophore block, binarised at 0.5). Use its predict_proba for class 1, rank-normalise it, and add it to the rank blend with weights 0.25 RF, 0.5 MLP, 0.25 NB (the MLP share stays the largest). Keep the descriptor features out of this model. Keep everything else unchanged.
backlog.title: Bernoulli naive Bayes as third blend member

backlog.spec: For each of the 8 MLPs, train on a bootstrap resample of the training rows (indices drawn with np.random.RandomState(seed+i)), with early_stopping=True. Average predict_proba across MLPs, then rank-blend with the RF as before. This adds diversity to the MLP half of the blend.
backlog.title: Bootstrap-bagged MLPs

backlog.spec: In fit_predict replace RandomForestClassifier with ExtraTreesClassifier (1000 trees, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=1, n_jobs=8, random_state=seed), keeping the descriptors+Gobbi features and the 5-seed MLP rank blend 50/50 unchanged. This replicates the earlier 0.0890 result exactly to test whether it is real.
backlog.title: Replicate ExtraTrees replacing RF

backlog.spec: Clean up the descriptor block before modeling, since RDKit's descList contains many near-duplicate and near-constant columns that add noise to both members of the blend. Inside fit_predict, compute the filter on the training fold only: drop descriptor columns with training standard deviation below 1e-8, then greedily drop any remaining descriptor column whose absolute Pearson correlation with an already-kept column exceeds 0.95 (iterate columns in order, keep the first of each correlated group). Apply the same column mask to the test fold. Leave the pharmacophore bits untouched, and leave the RF, the 5-seed MLP, and the 0.5/0.5 rank average exactly as they are.
backlog.title: Correlation and variance filter on the descriptor block

backlog.spec: Replace the RF with ExtraTreesClassifier (1000 trees, max_features 0.5, min_samples_leaf 1). Also append log1p Morgan count fingerprints (radius 2, folded to 1024) to the features for both the ExtraTrees and the MLP inputs. Keep the rank blend 50/50.
backlog.title: ExtraTrees plus log1p Morgan counts

backlog.spec: Replace the early-stopping MLP ensemble with a fixed, gentler optimization schedule, which removes the variance that comes from each seed stopping at a different and noisily chosen epoch. Use 8 MLPClassifier members with hidden_layer_sizes=(256, 64), alpha=1e-2, solver='adam', learning_rate_init=3e-4, batch_size=64, early_stopping=False, max_iter=120, n_iter_no_change=120, tol=0.0 and random_state=seed+i for i in range(8), all fitted on the quantile-normal transformed training fold, and average their predicted probabilities. Suppress ConvergenceWarning. Keep the RF and the 0.5/0.5 rank average exactly as they are. Check runtime: 8 members times 15 folds must fit in 10 minutes, so if the job is slow reduce to 6 members rather than cutting max_iter.
backlog.title: Fixed-schedule Adam MLP ensemble without early stopping

cand.description: Replace the MLPs' random 10% early-stopping split with a scaffold-disjoint inner validation split, training each MLP epoch by epoch and keeping the test predictions from the epoch with the best inner-validation AUROC.

memo: Helped: only big moves. Morgan+RF (0.1361) to quantile-transformed descriptors with SVC (0.1282/0.1277); adding the Gobbi pharmacophore fingerprint (0.1072); rank-blending RF with a 5-seed MLP (0.0926, incumbent). Nearly everything since was within noise (sd about 0.0049): XGBoost 0.0923, LightGBM 0.0903, CatBoost 0.0907, Tanimoto SVC 0.0909, MACCS 0.0914, log1p Morgan counts 0.0900. Worse: logistic regression 0.1037, FCFP 0.0967, stacking 0.0966, caching 0.0941, MQN/Gasteiger 0.0939, Morgan replacing Gobbi 0.0969, dropping Gobbi 0.0976, varied MLPs 0.0945. ExtraTrees replacing RF gave 0.0890 once, but other variants gave 0.0972, 0.0973 and 0.0947, so it is fragile. Several slots were wasted on aborted repeat ideas and 5 crashed (likely time or memory); check the history before proposing, and keep runtime under 10 minutes. Next: replicate ExtraTrees 0.0890 once; if it holds, combine it with log1p Morgan counts (0.0900). Avoid small swaps and untried feature repeats.
